summary: Existing 76 E2E tests sweep raw labels (RAW_LABEL_FORBIDDEN regex) across 4 viewports — all GREEN. ARIA: cart badge aria-live (components.jsx:67), promo error role=alert (funnel.jsx:187), notes char counter aria-live=polite (funnel.jsx:201, flows.jsx:90), OTP cells aria-label (account-v2.jsx:201), profile toggles aria-pressed (loyalty-v2.jsx:55), modal close aria-label (components.jsx:155). Touch targets 44px+ enforced via styles-mobile.css. Color palette flat orange/yellow/ink/cream — verified contrast at hero/buttons.

findings_p2.title: Login/Signup tabs lack role='tab' + tabpanel ARIA pattern
findings_p2.evidence: account-v2.jsx:75 <button className="lcf-tab">Connexion</button> + signup tab. Visually tabbed but no role=tab/tablist/aria-selected. Keyboard nav via arrow keys not handled.
findings_p2.recommendation: Add role='tablist' to wrapper, role='tab' + aria-selected on each, role='tabpanel' on form section, arrow-key handler. Defer to V1.0.2 (touch existing comp).

findings_p2.title: Burger button has aria-label='Menu' but no aria-expanded reflecting drawer state
findings_p2.evidence: components.jsx:77 <button className="lc-nav-burger" onClick={...} aria-label="Menu"> — opens mobile menu but aria-expanded not set.
findings_p2.recommendation: Add aria-expanded={open} + aria-controls='lc-mobile-menu' to burger button. Inline-edit ≤5 LOC = scope-minimal allowed.

findings_p2.title: Cart qty +/- buttons lack aria-label
findings_p2.evidence: flows.jsx:52 <button onClick={()=>updateQty(idx, -1)}>−</button> — screen reader hears just '−' character.
findings_p2.recommendation: aria-label='Diminuer la quantité' / 'Augmenter la quantité'. Inline-edit OK.

findings_p2.title: Pickup day calendar buttons lack aria-label with full date
findings_p2.evidence: funnel.jsx:152 <button>AUJ / 14</button> — screen reader hears 'AUJ 14' without context. Could be 'Aujourd''hui jeudi 14 mai'.
findings_p2.recommendation: Add aria-label with full date verbose. Defer to V1.0.2 (touch funnel + date logic).

verdict: A11Y GOOD. Existing 76 tests sweep raw labels GREEN × 4 viewports. ARIA solid on critical surfaces (cart/promo/notes/OTP/modal). 4 P2 defensive ARIA polish backlogged. Recommend axe-core sweep added to E2E for ongoing regression detection (action this cycle).
